description: isFetchableUrl and refusalFor over a table of URLs. Only http and https are allowed, and this machine, its network and the metadata address are refused unless allowPrivate is set. Refused hosts are the /etc/hosts loopback names localhost.localdomain, localhost4, localhost4.localdomain4, localhost6, localhost6.localdomain6, ip6-localhost and ip6-loopback, loopback, unspecified and link-local IPv6, unique-local fc00::/7, IPv4-mapped IPv6 under the IPv4 rules, 0/8, 10/8, 127/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, 169.254/16 and 100.64/10, after one trailing dot is dropped and with IPv6 in the URL parser's spelling. Still allowed on purpose: 198.18/15, 64:ff9b::/96 and the deprecated site-local fec0::/10. Refusal text is null when the URL is fetchable.
